integrity: The all-length proof is a self-contained degree/incidence bound with an explicit matching construction. A separate reproducible finite checker and its actual output are embedded; finite enumerations do not replace the all-length proof. Published source claims and residual originality risks are distinguished.
scientific_limitations: Only ternary unordered source multisets, exactly two surviving symbols, and a list allowance of four are covered. The statement supplies exact maximum sizes for all source lengths at least two, but does not classify all maximizers. No independent validation or universal historical-priority proof is asserted.
title: Exact four-list capacity for ternary two-survivor multiset deletion
